content:
Our AI Researcher, Margarida Amândio, will take part in the 1st Civil Engineering Symposium, taking place on 19 May, presenting the paper titled "Towards the implementation of intelligent optimization systems for process management in pavement rehabilitation".


The paper Margarida will present is the result of her research into developing an optimisation system capable of assisting in the management and planning of pavement rehabilitation processes.


Given that this type of project depends not only on high-consumption equipment, but also causes delays and inconvenience to users by occupying part of the roadway, it is in the interest of the entities that maintain this infrastructure to complete this type of project at the lowest possible cost and duration. To find the best solution to this problem, this research used a genetic algorithm to develop a system that searches for equipment distributions that lead to the simultaneous minimisation of the cost and duration of pavement rehabilitation projects.


The presentation will take place virtually and is organised by ISEP. Find out more on the event website available here.
